posts.title: Tim Peters will be missed
posts.description: Tim spent a very long time in the early days of Python List teaching me all sorts of things I didn't know from my father's scattershot teaching as a child. posts.title: PyOpenGL 4.0.0b1 Released
posts.description: So we seem to have reached mostly-stable state for the PyOpenGL 4.0.0 release. There's no other planned major changes to the core library, so unless we see significant regressions we'll likely release 4.0.0 final over the next few weeks.
